title: Zone Builder
hook: Correction #2 creates the zone. Find the one candle that forms it.

launchpad.outcome: Separate Correction #1 from Correction #2, pick the zone-forming candle, set its boundaries, and tell a potential zone from an active or invalid one.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Which candle actually forms the zone?

takeaways: Correction #1 never creates the execution zone. Correction #2 does.
The zone is one candle: the last opposite-colour candle of Correction #2 before BOS #3.
A zone is only potential until BOS #3 occurs.
If price violates the far edge of the zone, the setup is invalid.
remember: CORRECTION #2 CREATES THE ZONE. BOS #3 ACTIVATES IT.

slides.headline: Build the zone, one decision at a time.
slides.line: Three rounds: demand, supply, and a zone that gets invalidated.
